calls.reason: The packet lacks an inspectable image, complete prompt, or independent discrepancy audit. Marcus's own list cannot establish that there are ten distinct errors.

T2I-CompBench documents convincing appearance alongside compositional failures. GenEval corroborates the gap: its best models achieved only 15% correctness on relative positioning and 35% on attribute binding.

Chain-of-Verification reduces but does not eliminate hallucinations; Kalai and Vempala establish a narrower statistical explanation. Neither settles the proposed reconstruction mechanism or its application to image errors.
Carlini demonstrates training-image reproduction, and Somepalli links memorization to captions and training data. Neither establishes the claimed causal role of missing originality assessment.
